meta.titulo: Tríplice · Three border markets, one store
meta.descripcion: Marketplace for Paraguay, Brazil and Argentina: prices in your currency, stores from Ciudad del Este, Foz do Iguaçu and Puerto Iguazú, and reviews from local buyers.

comun.avisoDemo: Tríplice is a demo store: products, sellers, reviews and payments are not real.

sugerencias.vacio: We couldn't find “{q}”. Try another word or browse the categories.

region.ayuda: Changes the currency of prices and the delivery times you see. You can change it anytime.
region.sinImpuestos: For now prices are shown before tax. Each country's taxes come in the next stage of the project.

precio.sinImpuesto: No local taxes: import duties are paid on delivery

inicio.bajada: Stores from Ciudad del Este, Foz do Iguaçu and Puerto Iguazú. Prices in your currency and reviews from people who live here.
inicio.confianza1: Compare each seller's price, rating and delivery time on the same page.
inicio.confianza2: See guaraníes, reais, pesos or dollars at today's rate. Change it at the top anytime.
inicio.confianza3: Written by buyers from all three countries, in their own language. Verified purchases carry a badge.

pie.legal: Portfolio project by William Zarza. Products, stores, reviews and payments are fictional or test-only. Photos: original models and CC0 Poly Haven models, shot in Blender.

error.titulo: Something went wrong on our side
error.texto: We couldn't load this page. Try again in a few seconds; if it keeps failing, go back home.
error.noEncontradoTexto: The link may be mistyped or the product is no longer sold. Search for what you need or go back home.

compra.agotado: Sold out: remove it or save it for later
compra.vacioTexto: Anything you add from a product page shows up here, priced in your currency with your country’s tax.
compra.cuponNoExiste: That coupon doesn’t exist. Check the spelling (for example, BIENVENIDA10).
compra.cuponVencido: That coupon has expired. Try BIENVENIDA10 for 10% off your first order.
compra.cuponAgotado: That coupon has reached its usage limit.

pagar.variosLocales: You pick up at {n} stores, each their own items
pagar.datosRetiro: Bring an ID and your order number to pick up.
pagar.notaStripe: Stripe test payment: nothing is charged. Use card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date and any code.
pagar.notaSimulado: This preview doesn’t have Stripe test keys yet: paying takes you to a simulator where you choose whether the test card is approved or declined. Nothing is charged.
pagar.protegida: Protected purchase: if something doesn’t arrive as pictured, the store swaps it or refunds you.
pagar.notaImpuestos: Taxes follow {pais}’s rules (approximate simulation). You pay in {moneda}: no conversion fee from your bank.
pagar.notaInternacional: You pay in {moneda}, with no local taxes.

errores.codigo_AR: The postal code has 4 digits (3370) or the new format (N3370ABC).
errores.zona_BR: Use the 2-letter state code (for example, PR).

generales.pago: We couldn’t reach Stripe. Wait a moment and try again; nothing was charged.

pagar.simuladorRechazo: The bank declined the card (insufficient funds or online purchases blocked). Try another card: nothing was charged.

entrar.porque1Texto: From the store to your door or the counter, with a PDF receipt.
entrar.porque2Texto: Up to 7 days after delivery, right from the order.
entrar.porque3Texto: Only buyers can review, which is why Tríplice reviews are useful.
